#### Release highlights

##### March 19, 2026

The following section outlines some release highlights for UiPath products deployed under Automation Cloud Dedicated and Test Cloud Dedicated on March 19, 2026. For comprehensive release notes, refer to the individual platform or product release notes.

**Orchestrator**
* Orchestrator enforces AI Trust Layer policies from Automation Ops.

##### March 12, 2026

The following section outlines some release highlights for UiPath products deployed under Automation Cloud Dedicated and Test Cloud Dedicated on March 12, 2026.

**Orchestrator**
* A new timeline section in the Job details panel shows the chronological progression of job states.

**Test Manager**
* You can select a specific host machine when executing test sets.
